p: right in the sight of the: Meaning, in respect to his predecessors, though he had his imperfections.
children: That is, for the fault the child is punished for unless he is guilty of the same.
twenty years old and above: So many as were able to bear weapons and go to war.
out of Israel for an hundred: That is, out of the ten tribes who had separated themselves before both from God and their true king.
with Israel: Therefore to think to have help from them, whom the Lord does not favour, is to cast off the help of the Lord.
if thou wilt go: If you will not give credit to my words.

give thee much more than this: He shows that if we depend only on God, we will not need to be troubled by these worldly things, for he will give at all times that which will be necessary if we obey his word.
Seir ten thousand: For the Idumeans whom David had brought to subjection rebelled under Jehoram Jehoshaphat's son.
rock: In 2Ki 14:7 this rock is called the city Sela.
army which Amaziah sent back: That is, the 100,000 of Israel.
bowed down himself before them: That where he should have praised God for his benefits and great victory, he fell from God and most vilely dishonoured him.
deliver their own people out of: He proves that whatever cannot save himself nor his worshipper is no god but an idol.
the king said unto him: Meaning the king.
smitten: So hard it is, for the carnal man to be admonished for his fault, that he condemns, mocks and threatens him who warns him: yea, imprisons him and puts him to death, 2Ch 16:10,18:26,24:21.

let us see one another in: That is, let us try the matter hand to hand: for he was offended, that the army of the Israelites whom he had in wages and dismissed by the counsel of the prophet, had destroyed certain of the cities of Judah.

it came of God: Thus God often plagues by those means on which men must rely, to teach them to seek help only from him, and to show his judgments, he moves their hearts to follow that which will lead to their destruction.
Obededom: Meaning, the successors of Obededom: for the house bore the name of the chief father.
